ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its tables. The story sheet of a project reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.newsroom-sheet-db owns them.

rules.sheet: The description of the fields (codes, names, kinds, choices) as it was when the sheet was filled, so the names travel with the project.
rules.values: One value per field code; a save replaces every value. A code is lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
